subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about reactivating dormant riders on Bolt. A timely shift worth flagging: Lagos drivers have petitioned the state assembly to cap platform commission at 5%, against current take rates that reach 25%, so every margin point now rides on retained trips rather than fresh installs. With rider acquisition near $25 a head and the economics only working past a 3:1 LTV-to-CAC line, reactivation is where the cheaper volume sits. We measure recovered rides against a holdout so the trips show as incremental. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: Lagos 5% commission-cap petition (sourced) + rider CAC and 3:1 LTV:CAC band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ride_hailing retargeting: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (Lagos 5% commission-cap petition vs 25% current take) + market band (rider CAC ~$25, 3:1 LTV:CAC); brand rotated to Bolt (in candidates); MobUpps holdout reference, no figure; market context web-sourced; 1 question mark; no sign-off; X-not-Y avoided.
